child.text:
[{"insert":"Goblet Front Foot Elevated Split Squat

Elevating the front foot deepens the split squat, stretching the hip flexor of the back leg and increasing the range of motion through the front knee. The goblet position keeps the torso upright and shifts the demand forward into the quad of the front leg. All reps are prescribed at RPE 8 to 10. These should be working hard from the first set. Keep the front heel planted throughout.
"}]
